title: Automatic stabilisers for multi-country issuance stablecoins
title_primary: Automatic stabilisers for multi-country issuance stablecoins
authors: Edoardo D. Martino, Eric Monnet, Enrico Perotti
abstract: Multi-country issuance allows the same stablecoin to be issued by legally separate entities in different jurisdictions while circulating as a single, technologically fungible token. This structure creates a specific risk for Europe. In a run, holders can direct redemptions towards the jurisdiction offering the fastest, cheapest, or legally safest exit, and because Europe’s Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation provides stronger and less flexible redemption rights than the emerging US regime, dollar stablecoin runs originating elsewhere may concentrate on the EU issuer. This column proposes various steps to reform MiCAR and avoid multi-country issuance risks.

title: On Zombie Banks and Recessions after Systemic Banking Crises
title_zh: 僵尸银行与系统性银行危机后的衰退
title_primary: 僵尸银行与系统性银行危机后的衰退
title_secondary: On Zombie Banks and Recessions after Systemic Banking Crises
official: 官方在线 2015-11-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: What costs do zombie banks impose on society? We analyze the effects of government and central bank interventions in 68 systemic banking crises since 1980, of which 28 are part of the recent global financial crisis. Our estimation approach controls for the correlation between intervention measures and the time-invariant component of unobservable crisis severity. We find that timely bank recapitalizations substantially reduce the duration of recessions, underscoring the distortions caused by zombie banks and the costs of regulatory forbearance.
abstract_zh: 僵尸银行给社会带来了哪些成本？我们分析了自1980年以来68次系统性银行危机中政府和中央银行干预的效果，其中28次属于近期的全球金融危机。我们的估计方法控制了干预措施与危机严重程度中不随时间变化的不可观测成分之间的相关性。研究发现，及时的银行资本重组能显著缩短经济衰退的持续时间，凸显了僵尸银行造成的扭曲以及监管宽容的成本。

title: Why Veil? Religious Headscarves and the Economic Role of Women
title_zh: 为何戴头巾？宗教头巾与女性的经济角色
title_primary: 为何戴头巾？宗教头巾与女性的经济角色
title_secondary: Why Veil? Religious Headscarves and the Economic Role of Women
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-19 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We show that the emergence of new economic opportunities that draw women away from their traditional domestic roles has significantly influenced the adoption of religious veiling. We measure the prevalence of veiling among young women across Indonesia's districts for more than two decades by hand-coding around a quarter million photographs attached to Indonesia's public high school registers. To establish causality, we exploit exogenous variation generated by international demand for Indonesia's products, interacted with the gender and sectoral composition of local industries. Districts exposed to stronger positive economic shocks---and thus greater economic opportunities for women---exhibit higher rates of veiling adoption. Our findings suggest that veiling facilitates young women's participation in formal labor markets while safeguarding their personal and social image in society.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，吸引女性脱离传统家庭角色的新兴经济机会显著影响了宗教面纱的采用。我们通过手工编码印度尼西亚公立高中注册表上附带的约二十五万张照片，衡量了二十多年来印尼各地区年轻女性佩戴面纱的普遍程度。

title: The Employment Effects of a Guaranteed Income: Experimental Evidence from Two U.S. States
title_zh: 保障性收入对就业的影响：来自美国两州的实验证据
title_primary: 保障性收入对就业的影响：来自美国两州的实验证据
title_secondary: The Employment Effects of a Guaranteed Income: Experimental Evidence from Two U.S. States
authors: Eva Vivalt, Elizabeth Rhodes, Alexander Bartik, David Broockman, Patrick Krause 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the causal impacts of income on a rich array of employment outcomes, leveraging an experiment in which 1,000 low-income individuals were randomized into receiving $1,000 per month unconditionally for three years, with a control group of 2,000 participants receiving $50/month. We gather detailed survey data, administrative records, and data from a mobile phone app. The transfer caused total individual income excluding the transfers to fall by about $1,900/year relative to the control group and a 4.2 percentage point decrease in labor market participation. Participants reduced their work hours as a result of the transfers by 1-2 hours/week and participants’ partners reduced their work hours by a comparable amount. Among other categories of time use, the greatest increase generated by the transfer was in time spent on leisure. Despite asking detailed questions about amenities, we find no impact on quality of employment, and our confidence intervals can rule out even small improvements. Treated participants broadly increase expenditures, led by spending on non-durable goods and services, with smaller increases in spending on durable goods and human capital. We observe no significant effects on degree attainment, though the magnitudes of the estimated effects generally appear larger among younger participants. Measures of subjective well-being are higher among treated participants in the first year of the transfers but then revert to control group levels. Overall, our results suggest a moderate labor supply effect that does not appear offset by other productive activities.
abstract_zh: 我们研究收入对一系列就业结果的因果影响，利用了一项实验，其中1000名低收入个体被随机分配为每月无条件获得1000美元，为期三年，对照组2000名参与者每月获得50美元。我们收集了详细的调查数据、行政记录以及手机应用数据。转移支付导致除转移外个人总收入相对于对照组每年下降约1900美元，劳动力市场参与率下降4.2个百分点。参与者因转移支付而减少工作时间每周1-2小时，且参与者的伴侣也减少了相当数量的工作时间。在其他时间使用类别中，转移支付带来的最大增加是休闲时间。尽管我们询问了关于工作条件的详细问题，但未发现对就业质量的影响，且我们的置信区间可以排除即使是微小的改善。受助参与者总体上增加了支出，主要由非耐用品和服务支出带动，耐用品和人力资本支出增加较小。我们未观察到对学位获得的显著影响，尽管估计效应的大小在年轻参与者中通常显得更大。在转移支付的第一年，受助参与者的主观幸福感指标较高，但随后恢复到对照组水平。总体而言，我们的结果表明存在适度的劳动力供给效应，且这一效应并未被其他生产性活动所抵消。

title:
Tariff Transmission Across
                    US
                    Customs Districts: Product‐Level Evidence From Successive Trade Shocks
title_zh: 美国海关各区关税传导：来自连续贸易冲击的产品层面证据
title_primary: 美国海关各区关税传导：来自连续贸易冲击的产品层面证据
title_secondary:
Tariff Transmission Across
                    US
                    Customs Districts: Product‐Level Evidence From Successive Trade Shocks
authors: Wenhao Yao, Shimiao Su, Yunan Yao
abstract: This paper asks how US tariffs on Chinese imports reshape trade across the nation's customs districts, and whether a district's earlier reliance on China shapes how deeply its imports fall. We build a monthly panel of HS6‐level US imports from eleven source countries arriving through eight customs districts between January 2017 and December 2025, and estimate product‐specific import‐demand elasticities by Poisson Pseudo‐Maximum Likelihood with three‐way high‐dimensional fixed effects. The estimated elasticity, which we interpret as a conditional import‐demand response among observed foreign suppliers rather than a fully structural Armington parameter, is substantially larger than earlier nationally aggregated studies have reported. This gap matters because it suggests that aggregation across entry points and product categories has long hidden how severe the trade destruction really is. Districts heavily dependent on Chinese imports before the tariff wave experience much sharper declines than less‐exposed ports. The pattern is sharpest for differentiated goods in which Chinese suppliers had already dominated before the tariff hit, where no obvious alternative source stands ready to absorb displaced demand. A further decomposition separates the contemporaneous response from anticipatory pre‐positioning and shows that a nontrivial share of what has been called the static elasticity actually reflects firms acting on expectations of future tariffs. Trade diversion flows mainly towards ASEAN economies, and distance plays essentially no role.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了美国对华进口关税如何重塑全国各海关地区的贸易格局，以及某一地区早期对中国的依赖程度是否影响其进口下降的深度。我们构建了一个月度面板数据集，涵盖2017年1月至2025年12月期间，来自11个来源国、经由8个海关地区进入美国的HS6级进口数据，并采用带有三维高维固定效应的泊松伪极大似然法估计产品层面的进口需求弹性。我们所估计的弹性，被解释为观测到的外国供应商之间的条件性进口需求反应，而非完全结构化的阿明顿参数，其数值显著大于此前全国性汇总研究的结果。这一差异至关重要，因为它表明，跨入境点和产品类别的汇总长期以来掩盖了贸易破坏的严重程度。在关税浪潮前高度依赖中国进口的地区，其进口下降幅度远大于暴露程度较低的港口。这一模式在差异化产品中最为显著，尤其是那些中国供应商在关税冲击前已占据主导地位的产品，这些产品缺乏明显的替代来源来吸收被转移的需求。进一步的分解将同期反应与预期性提前备货区分开来，并表明所谓的静态弹性中，有相当一部分实际上反映了企业基于对未来关税的预期而采取的行动。贸易转移主要流向东盟经济体，而距离因素几乎不起作用。

title: The Impact of Manipulated Clinical Decision Support Algorithm on Opioid Prescribing Decision
title_zh: 操纵性临床决策支持算法对阿片类药物处方决策的影响
title_primary: 操纵性临床决策支持算法对阿片类药物处方决策的影响
title_secondary: The Impact of Manipulated Clinical Decision Support Algorithm on Opioid Prescribing Decision
abstract: We document that interactions with manipulated clinical decision support (CDS) systems can induce not only short-term, but also long-term changes in physicians’ opioid prescribing behavior. Physicians in our sample adopted electronic health record software from a list of federally certified vendors in 2011. Between 2016 and Spring 2019, one vendor secretly embedded a biased CDS function designed to promote extended-release opioid sales. Affected physicians not only increased opioid claims relative to the control group during the treatment window, but also maintained a higher propensity to prescribe opioids, even after the biased function was removed. This long-term behavioral change persisted even after affected physicians moved to new locations, changed their affiliations, or faced stricter state-level opioid regulations. Increasing physician awareness helped mitigate this impact. Using machine-learning algorithms, we estimate that decision-making distortion accounts for approximately 54% of the treatment effects in a physician decision model with dynamic learning. This paper was accepted by Hemant Bhargava, information systems. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07930 .
abstract_zh: 我们记录到，与受操纵的临床决策支持（CDS）系统的交互不仅会引发医生阿片类药物处方行为的短期变化，还会导致长期改变。在我们的样本中，医生于2011年从联邦认证供应商名单中采用了电子健康记录软件。在2016年至2019年春季期间，一家供应商秘密嵌入了一个旨在促进缓释阿片类药物销售的偏倚CDS功能。受影响的医生不仅在治疗窗口期内相对于对照组增加了阿片类药物索赔，而且在偏倚功能被移除后，仍保持较高的阿片类药物处方倾向。这种长期行为变化甚至在受影响的医生迁往新地点、更换隶属关系或面临更严格的州级阿片类药物监管后依然持续。提高医生的认知有助于缓解这一影响。利用机器学习算法，我们估计在具有动态学习的医生决策模型中，决策扭曲约占治疗效应的54%。本文被信息系统领域的Hemant Bhargava接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07930获取。

title: When the news you watch shapes the inflation you expect
title_zh: 你所观看的新闻如何塑造你预期的通胀
title_primary: 你所观看的新闻如何塑造你预期的通胀
title_secondary: When the news you watch shapes the inflation you expect
authors: Selva Demiralp, Orkun Saka, Michael Weber
abstract: Central banks lean on communication to anchor inflation expectations. But most households learn about the economy from the news rather than from policy statements, and in polarised societies, different outlets cover the same inflation very differently. Drawing on household panel data, television transcripts, and a randomised experiment in Turkey, this column shows that heavier inflation coverage on a viewer’s preferred channel raises their inflation expectations, an effect driven almost entirely by viewers of politically neutral channels. Partisan audiences barely respond, updating only to sources they already trust. Political segmentation of the media can therefore erode the common information base on which anchored expectations depend.
abstract_zh: 中央银行倚重沟通来锚定通胀预期。然而，多数家庭是从新闻而非政策声明中了解经济状况，在极化社会中，不同媒体对同一通胀现象的报道方式大相径庭。基于家庭面板数据、电视节目文稿及在土耳其进行的一项随机实验，本专栏指出，观众偏好频道对通胀报道的增多会推高其通胀预期，这一效应几乎完全由观看政治中立频道的观众驱动。党派倾向的观众反应甚微，仅会依据其已信任的信息源进行调整。因此，媒体的政治分化可能侵蚀锚定预期所依赖的共同信息基础。

title: Kinky Europe: Evidence from the regional Phillips curve in the euro area
title_zh: 扭曲的欧洲：来自欧元区区域菲利普斯曲线的证据
title_primary: 扭曲的欧洲：来自欧元区区域菲利普斯曲线的证据
title_secondary: Kinky Europe: Evidence from the regional Phillips curve in the euro area
abstract: We estimate the slope of the Phillips curve in the euro area, allowing for nonlinearities—or kinks—in the relationship between labor market slack and inflation. We exploit cross-country variation in labor market conditions in the period 2001–2024, absorbing aggregate shocks and endogenous monetary policy reactions with time fixed effects. We find that, while the Phillips curve is usually quite flat, it becomes at least three times steeper when the labor market is sufficiently tight. This kink is more pronounced in the euro area than in the United States, potentially due to more rigid labor markets. Our estimates suggest, however, that despite this nonlinearity, most of the post-pandemic inflation surge is attributable to factors other than labor market tightness.
abstract_zh: 我们估计了欧元区菲利普斯曲线的斜率，并允许劳动力市场松弛与通胀之间的关系存在非线性——即拐点。我们利用2001-2024年期间各国劳动力市场状况的跨国差异，通过时间固定效应吸收了总体冲击和内生性货币政策反应。研究发现，尽管菲利普斯曲线通常较为平坦，但当劳动力市场足够紧张时，其斜率至少会陡峭三倍。这一拐点在欧元区比美国更为显著，可能源于欧元区更为僵化的劳动力市场。然而，我们的估计表明，尽管存在这种非线性特征，疫情后通胀飙升的主要原因并非劳动力市场紧张，而是其他因素。

title: Assessing the 'Engines of Liberation': Home Appliances and Female Labour Force Participation
title_zh: 评估“解放引擎”：家用电器与女性劳动力参与
title_primary: 评估“解放引擎”：家用电器与女性劳动力参与
title_secondary: Assessing the 'Engines of Liberation': Home Appliances and Female Labour Force Participation
official: 官方在线 2006-05-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The secular rise in female labour force participation, highlighted in the recent macroeconomics literature on growth and structural change, has been associated with the declining price and wider availability of home appliances. This paper uses a new and unique country dataset on the price of home appliances to test its impact on female labour supply. We assess the role of the price of appliances in raising participation by comparing it to other structural determinants such as average male income. A decrease in the relative price of appliances - the ratio of the price of appliances to the consumer price index - leads to a substantial and statistically significant increase in female labour force participation. In the United Kingdom, for instance, the decline in the relative price of home appliances accounts alone for about 10 to 15 percent of the increase in female labour force participation from 1975 to 1999. This result is robust to the inclusion of additional controls, such as country dummies, time trend, government spending, capital to output ratio, and the growth rate of real GDP. To assess causality, we test for exogeneity and use the manufactured price index as an instrumental variable, confirming that lower appliance prices lead to increased female participation.
abstract_zh: 近期关于增长与结构变化的宏观经济学文献强调，女性劳动参与率的长期上升与家用电器价格下降及普及率提高密切相关。本文利用全新的国家层面家电价格数据集，检验其对女性劳动供给的影响。通过将家电价格与男性平均收入等其他结构性决定因素进行对比，我们评估了家电价格在提升女性劳动参与率中的作用。家电相对价格（即家电价格与消费者价格指数之比）的下降，显著且具有统计意义地提高了女性劳动参与率。以英国为例，1975年至1999年间，家用电器相对价格的下降单独解释了女性劳动参与率增长的10%至15%。在加入国家虚拟变量、时间趋势、政府支出、资本产出比及实际GDP增长率等额外控制变量后，该结果依然稳健。为评估因果关系，我们进行了外生性检验，并采用制造业价格指数作为工具变量，进一步证实了家电价格下降会促进女性劳动参与率提升。

title: The Causal Effects of Global Supply Chain Disruptions on Macroeconomic Outcomes: Evidence and Theory
title_zh: 全球供应链中断对宏观经济结果的因果效应：证据与理论
title_primary: 全球供应链中断对宏观经济结果的因果效应：证据与理论
title_secondary: The Causal Effects of Global Supply Chain Disruptions on Macroeconomic Outcomes: Evidence and Theory
authors: Bai, Xiwen, Fernández-Villaverde, Jesús, Li, Yiliang, Zanetti, Francesco
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We study the causal effects of global supply chain disruptions by constructing a new index of real-time port congestion using Automatic Identification System data from container ships and a spatial clustering algorithm. We develop a model with search frictions between producers and retailers that links upstream production slack to downstream supply shortages and captures output and price responses to supply chain shocks. The co-movements of output, prices, spare capacity, and market tightness provide novel identification restrictions. We find demand and supply shocks drove US disinflation in 2020, while the inflation surge in 2021 was driven mainly by supply chain shocks.
abstract_zh: 我们通过利用集装箱船舶的自动识别系统数据与空间聚类算法，构建了一个实时港口拥堵指数，以此研究全球供应链中断的因果效应。我们建立了一个包含生产商与零售商之间搜索摩擦的模型，该模型将上游生产闲置与下游供应短缺联系起来，并捕捉了产出和价格对供应链冲击的反应。产出、价格、闲置产能和市场紧度的协同变动提供了新的识别约束条件。研究发现，2020年美国通胀放缓主要由需求与供给冲击驱动，而2021年的通胀飙升则主要源于供应链冲击。

title: 数字技术应用与财政支出效率——来自预算管理一体化的证据
title_zh: 数字技术应用与财政支出效率——来自预算管理一体化的证据
title_primary: 数字技术应用与财政支出效率——来自预算管理一体化的证据
official: 官方发布 2026-07-20 · 来源：CNKI RSS
abstract: 财政紧平衡背景下，如何提高财政支出效率、提升财政支撑现代化建设的能力成为备受关注的话题。数字技术应用正在引领国家治理方式变革，但其能否在提升财政支出效率中发挥积极作用，仍有待深入探讨。本文依托预算管理一体化这一财政管理数字化的核心工程，利用2016—2022年的地级市面板数据，实证分析了数字技术应用对财政支出效率的影响。研究发现，一体化系统上线显著提高了地方财政支出效率；其中，提高预算过程管理效能、优化预算资源配置是预算管理一体化促进支出效率提高的重要机制。异质性分析显示，预算管理一体化的作用在政府规模较大、财政自主权较高、前期财政支出效率较低的城市中更强。最后，本文未能发现预算管理一体化对缓解财政压力有显著作用，这意味着本文发现的效率提升，更多来自产出端的改进，并没有破除支出扩张冲动与促进增收。本文为评估数字技术促进国家治理的成效提供了来自财政领域的证据，对进一步健全现代预算制度有所启示。
abstract_zh: 财政紧平衡背景下，如何提高财政支出效率、提升财政支撑现代化建设的能力成为备受关注的话题。数字技术应用正在引领国家治理方式变革，但其能否在提升财政支出效率中发挥积极作用，仍有待深入探讨。本文依托预算管理一体化这一财政管理数字化的核心工程，利用2016—2022年的地级市面板数据，实证分析了数字技术应用对财政支出效率的影响。研究发现，一体化系统上线显著提高了地方财政支出效率；其中，提高预算过程管理效能...

title: Knowledge Access: The Effects of Carnegie Libraries on Innovation
title_zh: 知识获取：卡内基图书馆对创新的影响
title_primary: 知识获取：卡内基图书馆对创新的影响
title_secondary: Knowledge Access: The Effects of Carnegie Libraries on Innovation
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Between 1883 and 1919, Andrew Carnegie funded the construction of more than 1,500 public libraries across the United States, reducing the costs of accessing knowledge for millions. We study the effect of these libraries on innovation. Patenting in recipient places increased on average by 10%–12% in the 20 years following library construction relative to a novel control group of cities that applied for but did not build libraries. We show that access to scientific knowledge and increased collaboration opportunities are possible mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 1883年至1919年间，安德鲁·卡内基在美国资助建造了超过1500座公共图书馆，降低了数百万人获取知识的成本。我们研究了这些图书馆对创新的影响。与一组申请建造但未建成图书馆的新颖对照组城市相比，受资助地区在图书馆建成后的20年间，专利数量平均增长了10%–12%。研究表明，获取科学知识的机会增加以及合作机会的增多是可能的机制。

title: Ideological Alignment and Evidence-Based Policy Adoption
title_zh: 意识形态一致性对循证政策采纳的影响
title_primary: 意识形态一致性对循证政策采纳的影响
title_secondary: Ideological Alignment and Evidence-Based Policy Adoption
authors: Jorge García-Hombrados, Marcel Jansen, Ángel Martínez, Berkay Özcan, Pedro Rey-Biel 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The implementation of evidence-based policies hinges on the dissemination of evidence to policymakers, a process influenced by the attributes of the sender. We conducted a nationwide RCT with ideologically opposite think tanks, major newspapers, and a research institution with nonsalient ideology to communicate a nonideological, cost-effective policy to local policymakers. Results show a 65 percent increase in policy adoption when informing institutions align ideologically with policymakers. We compare the impact of think tanks versus media outlets on implementation, finding both equally effective when ideologically aligned. We explore three actions where ideology may influence adoption: information exposure, belief updating and implementation. (JEL C93, D72, D78, D83, I23)
abstract_zh: 循证政策的实施依赖于向政策制定者传播证据，这一过程受到信息发送方特征的影响。我们开展了一项全国性随机对照试验，由意识形态对立的智库、主流报纸以及一家意识形态不显著的研究机构，向地方政策制定者传达一项非意识形态、具有成本效益的政策。结果显示，当信息传递机构与政策制定者意识形态一致时，政策采纳率提高了65%。我们比较了智库与媒体在政策实施中的影响，发现两者在意识形态一致时效果相当。我们探讨了意识形态可能影响政策采纳的三个环节：信息暴露、信念更新与实施。（JEL分类号：C93, D72, D78, D83, I23）

title: Promoting Healthier Drinking: Evidence From a Vignette Experiment on Contextual and Informational Drivers of Dealcoholized Wine Choices
title_zh: 促进健康饮酒：情境与信息因素对无醇葡萄酒选择影响的场景实验证据
title_primary: 促进健康饮酒：情境与信息因素对无醇葡萄酒选择影响的场景实验证据
title_secondary: Promoting Healthier Drinking: Evidence From a Vignette Experiment on Contextual and Informational Drivers of Dealcoholized Wine Choices
authors: Giovanna Piracci, Giulia Maesano, Leonardo Casini, Maurizio Canavari, Marija Cerjak
abstract: Growing demand for healthier beverages is driving innovation in the wine sector, with dealcoholized wine emerging as a promising alternative. However, little is known about the contextual conditions under which consumers would choose dealcoholized wine, particularly in countries with strong wine traditions. To fill this gap, this work examines how situational factors and information treatments influence consumers' willingness to switch from traditional to dealcoholized wine in Italy and Croatia, two countries with different wine consumption traditions. Using a vignette‐based experiment administered to 1600 wine consumers, this study analyses how consumption context and product information affect the likelihood of choosing dealcoholized wine over conventional alternatives. The results show that, although conventional wine remains the preferred option under standard conditions, the likelihood of switching to dealcoholized wine increases when a driving constraint is introduced. Informational treatments significantly affect choices in Italy, whereas Croatian consumers appear to respond more to functional constraints than to calorie or health messages. The findings have implications for producers and policymakers seeking to promote dealcoholized wines.
abstract_zh: 对更健康饮料的需求增长正推动葡萄酒行业创新，无醇葡萄酒正成为一种有前景的替代选择。然而，关于消费者在何种情境条件下会选择无醇葡萄酒，尤其是在具有深厚葡萄酒传统的国家，目前仍知之甚少。为填补这一空白，本研究考察了情境因素和信息处理如何影响意大利和克罗地亚（两个具有不同葡萄酒消费传统的国家）消费者从传统葡萄酒转向无醇葡萄酒的意愿。通过对1600名葡萄酒消费者进行基于情境实验的分析，本研究探讨了消费情境和产品信息如何影响选择无醇葡萄酒而非传统替代品的可能性。结果表明，尽管传统葡萄酒在标准条件下仍是首选，但当引入驾驶限制条件时，转向无醇葡萄酒的可能性增加。信息处理显著影响意大利消费者的选择，而克罗地亚消费者似乎对功能性限制的反应强于对卡路里或健康信息的反应。这些发现对寻求推广无醇葡萄酒的生产商和政策制定者具有启示意义。

title: Patents, Antitrust, and Innovation: Evidence From the Xerox Case
title_zh: 专利、反垄断与创新：来自施乐案的证据
title_primary: 专利、反垄断与创新：来自施乐案的证据
title_secondary: Patents, Antitrust, and Innovation: Evidence From the Xerox Case
abstract: How does antitrust enforcement affect innovation when patents are the main barrier to entry? I address this question by empirically studying the US antitrust case against Xerox, the former monopolist in the market for plain-paper copiers. In 1975, Xerox accepted a consent decree whose primary remedy was compulsory licensing of all its copier-technology patents in the US and abroad. I show that this antitrust intervention promoted innovation by other firms in the copier industry, measured by a disproportionate increase in patenting in technology classes with a higher propensity for containing copier-related inventions. This effect is driven by Japanese competitors, whose patenting became more novel and diverse as they started developing smaller desktop copiers.
abstract_zh: 当专利构成主要进入壁垒时，反垄断执法如何影响创新？我通过实证研究美国针对施乐公司（前普通纸复印机市场垄断者）的反垄断案件来回答这一问题。1975年，施乐接受了同意令，其主要救济措施是强制许可其在美国及国外的所有复印机技术专利。我证明，这一反垄断干预促进了其他企业在复印机行业的创新，表现为在更可能包含复印机相关发明的技术类别中，专利数量不成比例地增加。这一效应由日本竞争者驱动，随着他们开始开发更小的台式复印机，其专利变得更加新颖和多样化。

title: Aris Trantidis, Clientelism. Shaftesbury Road, Cambridge: Cambridge University Press, 2025. iv + 84 pages. USD 23 (paperback)
title_zh: 《庇护主义》
title_primary: 《庇护主义》
title_secondary: Aris Trantidis, Clientelism. Shaftesbury Road, Cambridge: Cambridge University Press, 2025. iv + 84 pages. USD 23 (paperback)
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In his latest book, Dr. Aris Trantidis offers a new theory of clientelism. Supported by a careful reconceptualization of the term that avoids both conceptual stretching and excessive narrowing, and drawing on evidence from case studies that normally remain underexamined in the wider public choice literature, such as Greece and Argentina, the author describes how clientelism is a fundamental force in liberal-democratic politics, holding electoral politics and public policy hostage to the interests of a caste of clients and rendering constitutional limits on clientelist power obsolete (Trantidis 2024). In the author’s words, “Clientelism refers to the provision of resources and advantages by political actors—the patrons—to their clients through an agreement in which these benefits are made conditional on the beneficiaries’ political support in return” (p. 6). The reciprocal transaction in the definition avoids conceptual stretching by excluding pork-barrel politics, which does not demand anything in return from constituencies (p. 8). Furthermore, it distances clientelism from general interest-group politics, which is a broader category that can include lobbying without an obligation on the part of the patron (p. 9). Moreover, it does not conceptually narrow clientelism to electoral dynamics alone. Past public choice articles have tended to analyze patron-client relations and interest group politics only to the extent they affect electoral processes. For example, one study examines systems in which political parties are dedicated to clientelist exchange, purely through electoral strategies of vote-buying and turnout-buying (Gans-Morse et al. 2014). By contrast, Trantidis makes an original contribution to the field by expanding our view of clientelism to arenas that do not ordinarily fall under scholarly scrutiny. These arenas constitute a layer of horizontal links across clients in various institutions (labor unions, state-owned enterprises, private companies), all interacting with public administration, parties, and individual patrons (p. 27). Such horizontal connections are important to highlight, Trantidis argues, because they represent a “preselectorate”, in that securing influential clients from such sectors determines who will have the resources to compete and win an election and select for the type of policy platform which must satisfy clients before traditional vertical relationships between policymakers and the electorate ever enter the picture (pg.45). Two empirical examples, Greece (p. 55) and Argentina (p. 66), are of utmost importance to Trantidis because they illustrate how clientelist interests override even the necessity of resolving a fiscal crisis (Argentina) or reversing known policy failures (Greece).
abstract_zh: 在其最新著作中，阿里斯·特兰蒂迪斯博士提出了一种关于庇护主义的新理论。通过对该术语进行细致的重新概念化，既避免了概念过度延伸，也防止了过度狭隘化，并借鉴了公共选择文献中通常较少考察的案例研究证据，如希腊和阿根廷，作者阐述了庇护主义如何成为自由民主政治中的一股根本力量，使选举政治和公共政策受制于一群庇护对象的利益，并使对庇护权力的宪法限制形同虚设（Trantidis 2024）。用作者的话说，“庇护主义指的是政治行动者——即庇护者——通过一种协议向其庇护对象提供资源和优势，这些利益以受益人提供政治支持作为回报为条件”（第6页）。该定义中的互惠交易排除了猪肉桶政治，从而避免了概念延伸，因为猪肉桶政治不要求选区提供任何回报（第8页）。此外，它使庇护主义区别于一般的利益集团政治，后者是一个更广泛的范畴，可以包括游说活动，而不要求庇护者承担义务（第9页）。再者，它并未在概念上将庇护主义局限于选举动态。以往的公共选择文章往往仅在影响选举过程的范围内分析庇护者-庇护对象关系和利益集团政治。例如，一项研究考察了政党致力于庇护交换的制度，纯粹通过买票和买 turnout 的选举策略来实现（Gans-Morse et al. 2014）。相比之下，特兰蒂迪斯通过将我们对庇护主义的视野扩展到通常不受学术审视的领域，为该领域做出了原创性贡献。这些领域构成了各机构（工会、国有企业、私营公司）中庇护对象之间的横向联系层，所有这些都与公共行政、政党和个别庇护者互动（第27页）。特兰蒂迪斯认为，这些横向联系值得强调，因为它们代表了一个“预选选民群体”，因为从这些部门获得有影响力的庇护对象决定了谁将拥有资源和能力来竞争并赢得选举，并选择必须满足庇护对象的政策平台类型，而这一切都发生在政策制定者与选民之间的传统纵向关系进入视野之前（第45页）。两个实证案例，希腊（第55页）和阿根廷（第66页），对特兰蒂迪斯至关重要，因为它们说明了庇护利益如何甚至凌驾于解决财政危机（阿根廷）或扭转已知政策失败（希腊）的必要性之上。

title: Patrilocal residence and young women’s status: Evidence from Sri Lanka
title_zh: 从夫居与年轻女性地位：来自斯里兰卡的证据
title_primary: 从夫居与年轻女性地位：来自斯里兰卡的证据
title_secondary: Patrilocal residence and young women’s status: Evidence from Sri Lanka
authors: Deborah S. DeGraff, Kone A.P. Siddhisena
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines the relationship between patrilocal residence and three types of indicators of young women’s status in Sri Lanka: autonomy measures, reproductive control outcomes, and experience of intimate partner violence. It makes several contributions to the literature on patrilocal residence and young women’s status in South Asia, and the broader literature on patriarchal norms and practices, through its focus on Sri Lanka in comparison to other South Asian countries, its attention to possible endogeneity and sample selection bias, and its emphasis on the importance of institutional context. Using data from the 2016 Demographic and Health Survey and invoking the perspective of intra-household bargaining power, we find evidence of detrimental effects of patrilocal residence on young women’s autonomy and reproductive control, effects that are likely underestimated if patrilocal residence is assumed to be exogenous. Some of these effects are weaker than those found for other South Asian countries, consistent with arguments about larger social and institutional context given the comparatively favorable metrics for Sri Lanka with respect to gender equality. We further explore this argument through analysis by sub-samples related to gender equity, finding that heterogeneity of the gender context within Sri Lanka affects the impact of patrilocal residence at the individual level. In most cases, negative effects of patrilocal residence on autonomy and reproductive control outcomes are less common and/or of lesser magnitude in situations identified as more gender egalitarian. The findings for intimate partner violence are less clear, and may be subject to under-reporting and/or sample selection.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了从夫居与斯里兰卡年轻女性地位的三类指标之间的关系：自主权衡量、生育控制结果以及亲密伴侣暴力的经历。本研究通过对斯里兰卡与其他南亚国家的比较，关注可能的内生性和样本选择偏差，并强调制度背景的重要性，为关于南亚从夫居与年轻女性地位的文献以及更广泛的父权规范与实践研究做出了多项贡献。利用2016年人口与健康调查数据，并借鉴家庭内部议价能力的视角，我们发现从夫居对年轻女性的自主权和生育控制有不利影响的证据，若假设从夫居为外生变量，这些影响可能被低估。其中一些影响弱于其他南亚国家发现的结果，这与关于更大社会与制度背景的论点一致，因为斯里兰卡在性别平等方面拥有相对有利的指标。我们进一步通过按性别平等相关的子样本分析来探讨这一论点，发现斯里兰卡内部性别背景的异质性影响从夫居在个体层面的作用。在大多数情况下，从夫居对自主权和生育控制结果的不利影响在更性别平等的环境中较少出现和/或程度较轻。关于亲密伴侣暴力的发现则不那么明确，可能受到低报和/或样本选择的影响。

title: Buyer‐Optimal Platform Design
title_zh: 买家最优的平台设计
title_primary: 买家最优的平台设计
title_secondary: Buyer‐Optimal Platform Design
abstract: A platform matches a unit mass of sellers, each owning a single product of heterogeneous quality, to a unit mass of buyers with differing valuations for unit-quality. After matching, sellers make take-it-or-leave-it price-offers to buyers. Initially, valuations of buyers are only known to them and the platform, but sellers make inferences from the matching algorithm. The efficient matching is positive assortative, but buyer-optimal matchings are stochastically negative assortative when there are few low-value buyers (i.e., compared to lower-quality sellers, high-quality ones are matched to buyers with lower expected valuation). Although everyone trades, generating rents for the side lacking bargaining power results in inefficient matching.
abstract_zh: 平台将单位质量的卖方（每位卖方拥有一件质量异质的产品）与单位质量的买方（对单位质量具有不同估值）进行匹配。匹配完成后，卖方对买方提出“要么接受，要么放弃”的价格报价。初始时，买方的估值仅为其自身和平台所知，但卖方会从匹配算法中进行推断。有效匹配是正选择性的，但当低价值买方数量较少时（即与低质量卖方相比，高质量卖方匹配到的买方预期估值更低），买方最优匹配在随机意义上是负选择性的。尽管所有交易均能达成，但为缺乏议价能力的一方创造租金会导致匹配效率低下。

title: An empirical study on machine learning-based future loss prediction for insurance firms: evidence from China’s property and casualty insurance sector
title_zh: 基于机器学习的保险公司未来损失预测实证研究：来自中国财产保险业的证据
title_primary: 基于机器学习的保险公司未来损失预测实证研究：来自中国财产保险业的证据
title_secondary: An empirical study on machine learning-based future loss prediction for insurance firms: evidence from China’s property and casualty insurance sector
authors: Yuan Zheng, Xunyang Li, Wei Zhong
abstract: Accounting estimates are crucial in financial reports, especially in the insurance industry, where actuaries’ estimates of future claims reserves directly affect corporate financial transparency and operational decisions. Existing research has revealed the uncertainty and subjectivity of traditional accounting estimation methods, and has recognized the positive role of machine learning, but pure machine learning faces the challenge of insufficient interpretability. Based on financial data of Chinese property insurance companies from 2014 to 2022, this paper selects five major insurance types, adopts three machine learning algorithms: random forest, gradient boosting machine, and NGBoost to predict future losses, and compares them with actuary predictions. The results show that the machine learning models are superior to actuary predictions in terms of indicators such as mean absolute error (MAE) and root mean square error (RMSE). After incorporating actuary prediction data into the model, accuracy and reliability are significantly improved. On this basis, this paper analyzes the interpretability of the optimal machine learning model through feature importance ranking, verifies the value of actuary predictions, and provides a feasible path for actuaries to transform into algorithm supervisors and auditors.
abstract_zh: 会计估计在财务报告中至关重要，尤其在保险行业中，精算师对未来索赔准备金的估计直接影响企业财务透明度及经营决策。现有研究已揭示传统会计估计方法的不确定性和主观性，并认识到机器学习的积极作用，但纯机器学习面临可解释性不足的挑战。基于2014年至2022年中国财产保险公司的财务数据，本文选取五大险种，采用随机森林、梯度提升机及NGBoost三种机器学习算法预测未来损失，并与精算师预测进行比较。结果显示，机器学习模型在平均绝对误差（MAE）和均方根误差（RMSE）等指标上优于精算师预测。将精算师预测数据纳入模型后，准确性和可靠性显著提升。在此基础上，本文通过特征重要性排序分析最优机器学习模型的可解释性，验证了精算师预测的价值，并为精算师转型为算法监督者和审计师提供了可行路径。

title: The unequal spirit of the Protestant Reformation: particularism and wealth distribution in early modern Germany
title_zh: 宗教改革的不平等精神：近代早期德国的特殊主义与财富分配
title_primary: 宗教改革的不平等精神：近代早期德国的特殊主义与财富分配
title_secondary: The unequal spirit of the Protestant Reformation: particularism and wealth distribution in early modern Germany
abstract: This paper assesses the impact of the Protestant Reformation on wealth distribution and inequality in confessionally divided Germany, between 1400 and 1800. The Reformation expanded social welfare, but provided it in a particularistic way to “deserving" poor and natives only. This gave Protestantism an ambiguous character in terms of redistribution and its impact on inequality. I develop a theoretical framework of this trade-off between welfare expansion and particularistic provision, and test its implications empirically, using a difference-in-differences and an instrumental variable strategy. In line with the theoretical framework, the analysis documents that the Reformation exacerbated inequality overall by making marginal poor people relatively poorer. This increase in inequality was driven by the introduction of new particularistic poor relief policies in Protestant communities. Economic growth was unlikely to be large enough to compensate poor strata for their losses. Protestantism emerges as an underappreciated driver of preindustrial inequality, long before the onset of industrialisation and modern economic growth.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了新教改革对1400至1800年间宗教分裂的德国财富分配与不平等状况的影响。改革扩大了社会福利，但仅以特殊主义方式提供给“值得”的穷人和本地居民。这使得新教在再分配及其对不平等的影响上呈现出矛盾特性。我构建了一个理论框架，探讨福利扩张与特殊主义供给之间的权衡，并采用双重差分法和工具变量策略对其含义进行实证检验。与理论框架一致，分析表明改革通过使边缘穷人相对更加贫困，总体上加剧了不平等。这一不平等加剧源于新教社区引入的新型特殊主义济贫政策。经济增长不太可能足以补偿贫困阶层所遭受的损失。新教由此显现为工业化及现代经济增长开始之前，一个未被充分认识的工业化前不平等驱动因素。
